name: Just a Piece
summary:
Just a Piece is a relaxing puzzle game about finding the right place for every piece.

Explore 50 handcrafted puzzles across 10 charming environments, each with its own atmosphere and music. Match geometric shapes, rotate and flip pieces, and discover how different combinations fit together to complete each board. With simple controls, a cozy atmosphere, and no need to rush, Just a Piece offers a peaceful puzzle-solving experience for players who enjoy taking their time.
